The '''Opitha Tren system''' was located in the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tren]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Cracken" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Opitha Tren [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square J-15.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', stated on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that Opitha Tren was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every [[Sector/Legends|sector]] listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> despite the fact that Opitha Tren is not actually assigned a specific sector by the Online Companion.<ref name="EAOC" />
